svg.title: Build a Controlled Fleet Launch in 30 Days
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-08-first-thirty-days-roadmap; chart type: timeline_roadmap; title: Build a Controlled Fleet Launch in 30 Days; subtitle: Four weekly milestones create a launch-ready operation without forcing an early first deal.; chapter number: 12; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Numeric values are milestone ending days: 7, 14, 21, and 30. The canonical time to first deal is 1–3 months. The sprint can finish with qualified prospects and complete documentation while insurer, licensing, or vehicle activation work continues.; caption: Maintain the supplied $2,500–$15,000 monthly operating-cost range as a planning envelope, not a universal runway estimate. Release dates follow completed evidence; acquisition volume does not override vehicle readiness or insured operating scope.; stages: label: Days 1-7; value: Define the service jurisdiction and obtain written operating requirements; numeric value: 7.0; detail: Choose one launch niche and geography. Obtain insurer quotes, identify applicable carrier or TLC authority, confirm platform vehicle requirements, and model the 55% retained share separately from passenger trip GMV. Deliver a priced launch worksheet and jurisdiction checklist.; label: Days 8-14; value: Document owner terms and configure auditable collections and ledgers; numeric value: 14.0; detail: Review vehicle-owner authority, draft driver terms, configure authorized payment collection, and create separate deposit, pass-through, and retained-contribution accounts. Deliver a sample owner statement that reconciles from gross billings to distributable amounts.; label: Days 15-21; value: Run a limited qualification and vehicle-readiness rehearsal; numeric value: 21.0; detail: Process a small authorized applicant cohort, inspect candidate vehicles, install approved telematics, and test maintenance alerts. Rehearse collision reporting, failed-payment handling, and stationary starter-inhibition controls without deploying an unsafe vehicle.; label: Days 22-30; value: Complete a settlement rehearsal and schedule only ready handovers; numeric value: 30.0; detail: Reconcile a labeled test dataset across billing, bank receipts, tolls, repairs, and owner splits. Where every requirement is complete, conduct a controlled handover; otherwise continue the documented 1–3 month first-deal plan without recording test collections as revenue.

text.title: Build a Controlled Fleet Launch in 30 Days
text.tspan: Build a Controlled Fleet Launch in 30 Days

circle.title: label: Days 1-7; value: Define the service jurisdiction and obtain written operating requirements; numeric value: 7.0; detail: Choose one launch niche and geography. Obtain insurer quotes, identify applicable carrier or TLC authority, confirm platform vehicle requirements, and model the 55% retained share separately from passenger trip GMV. Deliver a priced launch worksheet and jurisdiction checklist.

text.title: Define the service jurisdiction and obtain written operating requirements

circle.title: label: Days 8-14; value: Document owner terms and configure auditable collections and ledgers; numeric value: 14.0; detail: Review vehicle-owner authority, draft driver terms, configure authorized payment collection, and create separate deposit, pass-through, and retained-contribution accounts. Deliver a sample owner statement that reconciles from gross billings to distributable amounts.

text.title: Document owner terms and configure auditable collections and ledgers

circle.title: label: Days 15-21; value: Run a limited qualification and vehicle-readiness rehearsal; numeric value: 21.0; detail: Process a small authorized applicant cohort, inspect candidate vehicles, install approved telematics, and test maintenance alerts. Rehearse collision reporting, failed-payment handling, and stationary starter-inhibition controls without deploying an unsafe vehicle.

text.title: Run a limited qualification and vehicle-readiness rehearsal

circle.title: label: Days 22-30; value: Complete a settlement rehearsal and schedule only ready handovers; numeric value: 30.0; detail: Reconcile a labeled test dataset across billing, bank receipts, tolls, repairs, and owner splits. Where every requirement is complete, conduct a controlled handover; otherwise continue the documented 1–3 month first-deal plan without recording test collections as revenue.

text.title: Complete a settlement rehearsal and schedule only ready handovers

Assumptions: Numeric values are milestone ending days: 7, 14, 21, and 30. The canonical time to first deal is 1–3 months. The sprint can finish with qualified prospects and complete documentation while insurer, licensing, or vehicle activation work continues.
